boundary.description: A promise of the implement run that no engine check reads, with its one home.

enforcement.description: What stops a break: a tool that refuses (tool-refusal), a test that fails in make check (test), an assertion of the implement eval, which runs only on a paid agent run (eval), or only the prose (prose).

symbol.description: The function in enforced_by that refuses, fails or scores the break; Class.method for a test. Given with enforced_by, unless the enforcement is prose, when both are absent. The gate checks that the file defines it.

check_id.description: A check ID from audit/catalogue.json, in the PACK-NN form.

keep.description: The rule that keeps a touched read true (kept), or the maintainer's acceptance of the gap (accepted).

reason.description: Why the maintainer accepts that the move can change what the check reads.

move.description: What one playbook Commits row or one greenfield template does to text a check may read.

action.description: rewrite keeps the words and changes the line breaks, numbers or markers. untrack takes the from paths out of git's tracked set and leaves them on disk, so the scan no longer sees them. none: the row touches no text a check reads.

content.description: The kinds of content moved or written.

id.description: A unique id: the playbook or template folder, a slash and the row or path, such as adapt-agents-md/row-9.

intent.description: Why a created file has a name from the names list; required by the gate for such a file.

mode.description: add: the step only adds whole lines or keys to each to path, at a block boundary, in a file it does not create, and changes or removes nothing; the gate allows it only on a write whose Commits row names no edit word. replace, also when absent: the step may change or remove text.

row.description: The number in the playbook's Commits table; absent for a template.

step.description: The step that does the work, as the playbook names it.

touches.description: The checks whose reads this move can change, as a reviewer judged them. Each needs a keeps entry, or the gate lists the pair as unkept.

name.description: A file or folder name the engine gives a meaning to. A template or a created file whose path matches it needs a moves entry with an intent.

ignore_case.description: true when the engine compares the name case-insensitively; the test then lower-cases both sides.

path.description: A path relative to the repository root, with no leading slash, ./ or ../. A glob when the scope is glob.

quote.description: Where a sentence lives: a file, an index section address in that file, and a verbatim quote of the sentence.
The sentence, verbatim. Whitespace is collapsed before the compare.

section.description: The section address that dev/doc_index.py gives the section, such as implement/playbooks/adapt-agents-md.md#steps/generic.

read.description: One check's contract with the text it reads.

binding.description: How close the parts must be: on one physical line, within a window of lines, in one paragraph, in one section, or anywhere in the file.

constants.description: Engine constants that hold the file names, as module:NAME, such as audit.rules.checks.tst:_FASTPATH_DOCS. A test compares them with where.

named_by_text.description: The check also reads paths that the target's own text names, which where cannot list: why, in one line. Such a path is allowed when a file the same run read holds it.

source.description: engine: an engine rule reads the text. agent: the check page tells an agent what to read.

threshold.description: The pass level, in the check page's words.

text.description: The phrases or words, when the kind has them.

window.description: The window size in lines; only with binding window.

case.description: fold: the check matches the name in lower case, so a name in any case meets the place. Absent means an exact match.

monotone.description: Rule R5: text added to this place (whole lines or keys, at a block boundary, in a file that exists, nothing changed or removed) can only raise the check's verdict. A move with mode add infers no touch through it. Absent means it can lower the verdict.

scope.description: root: the exact path at the root. any-depth: the base name in any folder. repository-level: the root, .github/, .gitlab/ or docs/. glob: path is a glob from the root, where **/ also matches no folder. With any-depth and repository-level, path is a base name that may hold a wildcard, such as .prettierrc*.

unexercised.description: Why no fixture can make the check ask for this place, which its code reads. The recording test then does not require it to be seen.

via.description: The place is read upstream, before the check runs: scan-kind when the scan's file kinds (test, generated) match it by name, components when component detection reads it. The check asks for no such path itself.

description: The consistency map, joined from the part files that dev/consistency-map/index.json lists: what each check reads (reads), what each playbook Commits row and greenfield template writes or moves (moves), the rules that keep the two in step (keeps), the file names the engine gives a meaning to (names) and the implement run's boundaries (boundaries).
title: Consistency map
